exposure: Total placenta previa patients with and without prior cesarean section, anterior placenta, and placental lacunae
Placental position (total, partial, or marginal placenta previa)
finding: In women with total placenta previa, prior cesarean section, anterior placenta, and placental lacunae on ultrasound were associated with increased risk of bleeding-related complications, but total placenta previa patients without these factors had similar outcomes to those with partial or marginal placenta previa.
